title: OUD FOR GRACE
body:
OUD FOR GRACE is a Woody Ambery Spicy Eau de Parfum from the BLACK GOLD PROJECT collection. It offers a controlled, contemporary interpretation of Oud, combining depth, clarity and warmth.

Power no longer announces itself. It resides in presence, in composure, in the ability to command without display. Experience a new olfactory signature, where intensity is mastered, and power finds its most refined expression. A trail that speaks without excess. A presence that lingers, unmistakable.

Bergamot opens with luminous clarity. Precious woods and Oud create a deep, resonant structure. Vanilla and Praline add a subtle, addictive warmth, while Black Pepper brings tension and precision. The result is deep yet lifted, powerful yet perfectly balanced.

OUD FOR GRACE is a fragrance for those who embody authority effortlessly, with confidence that never needs to prove itself.

All our fragrances are unisex and made in France.

title: MAGNETIC BLEND 7
body: The superpower of MAGNETIC BLEND 7? Exalting all the others. Wear it alone to express your uniqueness, or layer it with another INITIO creation to enhance every facet of yourself. MAGNETIC BLEND 7 amplifies the captivating power of your skin's natural scent. When worn as a skin scent, it blends seamlessly with your body's chemistry, revealing a magnetic aura uniquely yours. YOUR SCENT, YOUR POWER.

title: ATOMIC ROSE
body:
A full Rose, scattered and bare, scarcely dressed with Jasmine and Vanilla Bean. So desirable and free of taboo, it makes you blush before you lose your head. A floral seduction that rises to a crescendo—timid and soft at first, then finally carrying everything in its sillage as if cast by a spell. Seduction intensifies, and raw attraction becomes inevitable. ATOMIC ROSE bursts forth like a confession, with a racing heart, exposed and vulnerable. Love reveals itself, explosive and untamed, where every moment burns with sincerity.

All our fragrances are unisex and Made in France.

title: PSYCHEDELIC LOVE
body:
A transgressive reference to feeling high, this fetishist composition has it all. The pairing of Rose and Heliotropin is both tender and illicit, soon joined by Hedione in a "ménage à trois" where each element is illuminated by the radiance of the other. First, it triggers a selfish pleasure, before it permeates, disrupting and ultimately subduing the other. Obsession takes shape. PSYCHEDELIC LOVE unfolds, enchanting and hypnotic. A gentle, endless fascination where time stretches, and the boundaries between body and mind blur.

All our fragrances are unisex and Made in France.

title: HIGH FREQUENCY
body:
When it blends with Hedione, the intriguingly discerning pairing of Magnolia and Almond creates a soundwave of love—gentle at first, then gradually rising in olfactory decibels on the skin until it reaches its climax. This passionate perfume has the gift of immersing the wearer in a state of seduction, where they dare because there’s nothing to lose. The connection becomes physical. HIGH FREQUENCY manifests in every heartbeat. It strikes, it pulses, it connects. A vivid wave flows across the skin, through the mind, electrifying instincts.

All our fragrances are unisex and Made in France.

title: ADDICTIVE VIBRATION
body:
Welcome to the irresistible promise of ADDICTIVE VIBRATION, a fragrance where instinct meets delicacy. Crisp Apple Blossom and radiant Orange Blossom blend with breezy white flowers, rich Honey, and sweet Vanilla Orchid to create a scent that is both exhilarating and uplifting. Soft waves of Musk follow, leaving a lingering trail, gentle yet magnetic. More than a fragrance, ADDICTIVE VIBRATION resonates like a whisper carried on a breeze, a subtle pulse that connects and transcends each moment. Instinctive, refined, and endlessly captivating, it offers a sophisticated sensory experience that lingers in the memory. Magnetic. Hypnotic. A timeless vibration for those who seek connection beyond the ordinary.

All our fragrances are unisex and Made in France.

title: ABSOLUTE APHRODISIAC
body:
Every person has a unique Absolute - a primal instinct that, once awakened, releases a remarkable power. In the alchemy of scent, opulent Vanilla, Musk and Castoreum merge to embody the true essence of an aphrodisiac. As it melts on your skin, radiant white flowers and rich Amber enhance its irresistible warmth, while Vanilla and Musk weave a sensual aura. The animalic touch of Castoreum adds a provocative edge that awakens your instincts and ignites passion. With ABSOLUTE APHRODISIAC, explore your inner depths, uncover your primal instincts and awaken your authentic self.

All our fragrances are unisex and Made in France.

title: MYSTIC EXPERIENCE
body:
Step into mystery with MYSTIC EXPERIENCE, a fragrance of intensity and intrigue. Mysterious and bold, it exudes a mystical energy where the tangible meets the invisible, awakening attraction and curiosity. Dark Coffee and sensual Musk create a magnetic aura, while warm Vanilla and earthy Patchouli add rich depth. Amber woods weave a hypnotic trail, inviting you to transcend the ordinary. MYSTIC EXPERIENCE is created for those who dare to explore the unknown.

All our fragrances are unisex and Made in France.

title: BLESSED BARAKA
body:
A strong connection to the divine, a source of power and an embodiment of infused blessing, where the purity of white flowers, the grounding essence of Sandalwood and the mystical aura of Musk come together to create the source of baraka and blessing. Surrounding the wearer with an intangible aura of power and grace, BLESSED BARAKA masterfully weaves a protective energy into a harmonious blend, evoking a sense of destiny and sacred purpose.

All our fragrances are unisex and Made in France.
